newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria places 1.6 bln levs 6-mth, coupon T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria places 1.6 bln levs 6-mth, coupon T-bills.

text.p: Bulgaria's Finance Ministry placed a special issue of six-month, floater coupon T-bills worth 1.6 billion levs and yielding 112.30 percent to maturity, the central bank said.

The coupon was set equal to the new lower central bank's main interest rate of 17.14 percent monthly or 205.68 percent annually, which went in force today. The previous main interest rate was 18 percent monthly.
In line with its usual practice the central bank did not say with which financial intitution or institutions the issue was placed on Friday.
Details of issue follow. Price in percent of par.
